cues.en: In this video we are continuing on our exploration of polynomials and working with polynomials in python.
cues.zh: 繼續探索多項式，以及 Python 裡的操作。

cues.en: In particular, here I'm going to focus on multiplying polynomials.
cues.zh: 這段聚焦多項式相乘。

cues.en: Now before I tell you how to multiply polynomials I want to give you a quick reminder of the law of exponents.
cues.zh: 之前先快速複習指數律，

cues.en: This is something that I covered in a previous video, in a previous section actually.
cues.zh: 前面影片，應該說前一章，已介紹過。

cues.en: So the idea is that if you have multiple variables that are multiplying each other and that have exponents you can add the exponents as long as the base is the same.
cues.zh: 如果多個有次方的變數相乘，只要底數相同，就能把指數相加，

cues.en: So this is X to the A and X to the B and that equals x the A plus B.
cues.zh: x 的 a 次方，乘以 x 的 b 次方，等於 x 的 a 加 b 次方。

cues.en: However, the Y and the X cannot be combined here Because Y is a different base from X.
cues.zh: 但 y、x 不能合併，因為底數不同。

cues.en: So with that as a quick reminder of the law of exponents, multiplying polynomials is actually pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 記得這點，多項式相乘其實很直接。

cues.en: So if have one polynomial here and this is a second polynomial.
cues.zh: 這裡一個，這裡另一個，

cues.en: Then the product between these two polynomials is this.
cues.zh: 兩個的乘積是這個，

cues.en: It's pretty long but it's not really difficult to compute.
cues.zh: 很長，但不難計算。

cues.en: Essentially what you have to do is expand all of the multiplications.
cues.zh: 基本上，把所有乘法展開。

cues.en: So this term X to the five, times this term gives you x to the six, and then you have this term times this term.
cues.zh: x 的五次方，乘上這一項，得到 x 六次方，再這項乘那項，

cues.en: Now the X is the same here.
cues.zh: x 相同，

cues.en: So we get X to the six and then of course the minus three and the Y. And then you keep going through this procedure methodically.
cues.zh: 所以得到 x 六次方，再乘 -3、y，依照步驟繼續。

cues.en: It takes a little while but eventually you will get to the final answer.
cues.zh: 花一點時間，最後就能得到答案，

cues.en: And then if you have any like terms then you can combine them.
cues.zh: 有同類項就合併，

cues.en: But in this case there are no common terms that are combinable.
cues.zh: 這題卻沒有能合併的項。

cues.en: For example, if this were X times Y to the two, if this were y squared, then these two terms could be combined.
cues.zh: 例如這裡如果是 x 乘以 y 平方，這裡如果是 y 平方，這兩項能合併，

cues.en: However it's not possible to combine them because this is y squared and this is y cubed.
cues.zh: 但實際一個 y 平方、一個 y 三次方，所以不能。

cues.en: Of course if these were multiplying each other you could combine them.
cues.zh: 如果相乘，當然能合併，

cues.en: But these are being subtracted. So once you know how to create polynomials and you know how to add them
cues.zh: 但這裡是相減。知道如何建立多項式，以及上一段的加，

cues.en: and subtract them from the previous video, multiplying polynomials isn't really too much different.
cues.zh: 減後，乘法其實沒差太多。

cues.en: So let's start by importing the sympy module as well as the display and math functions for nice printing.
cues.zh: 先匯入 SymPy，以及漂亮輸出的 display、Math。

cues.en: So let's start by creating a symbolic variable, so I'll say sym dot symbols X. And then just to show you the law
cues.zh: 建立符號變數，sym.symbols('x')，再示範指，

cues.en: of exponents again.
cues.zh: 數律。

cues.en: So here I have X to the fifth power times X to the let's say x to the third and now the result here
cues.zh: 這裡 x 五次方，乘以 x 的，例如三次方，結果，

cues.en: is going to be X to the eighth power, because these two terms are multiplying each other and their bases are the same.
cues.zh: 是 x 八次方，因為兩項相乘，底數又相同。

cues.en: Of course if we were to add them then we just get the same thing.
cues.zh: 如果相加，只會得到相同的式子，

cues.en: Basically we get X to the fifth plus X of the third.
cues.zh: 就是 x 五次方加 x 三次方，

cues.en: It's not possible in this case to reduce this expression any further.
cues.zh: 無法再化簡。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So this was a pretty simple multiplication between two polynomials.
cues.zh: 這是很簡單的兩個多項式相乘。

cues.en: Let's try something slightly more complicated, so I'll say P1 for polynomial 1.
cues.zh: 試稍微複雜的，p1 代表第一個多項式，

cues.en: Let's set that to be four times X squared minus two times x.
cues.zh: 設成 4x 平方減 2x，

cues.en: And then let's set polynomial two to be.
cues.zh: 第二個，

cues.en: How about X cubed minus one.
cues.zh: 用 x 三次方減 1。

cues.en: So now I can write P1 times P3 -- oops! P2.
cues.zh: 再寫 p1*p3，哎，是 p2。

cues.en: Now in this case sympy didn't actually write out all the expansion; it just left it exactly how I wrote it.
cues.zh: 這次 SymPy 沒完整展開，保留原本寫法，

cues.en: So this polynomial times this polynomial. If you want this to be expanded you can use the sympy function expand.
cues.zh: 這個多項式乘另一個。要展開，用 expand，

cues.en: So sympy dot expand and that will actually multiply out all the terms and we can have a quick look to make sure that this is all going as we expected it to.
cues.zh: sym.expand，會把每項乘開，快速檢查是否符合預期。

cues.en: So you have this term times this term and that's going to be four times x to the fifth power because you have X squared and X cubed here.
cues.zh: 這項乘這項，得到 4x 五次方，因為這裡 x 平方、x 三次方，

cues.en: So that's this term over here.
cues.zh: 對應這一項。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now I think this looks kind of ugly.
cues.zh: 這看起來有點醜，

cues.en: So what I'm going to do is expand this out using LaTeX formatting.
cues.zh: 用 LaTeX 格式顯示展開結果。

cues.en: So let's say I want display and then math and then sympy latex and then the expand function.
cues.zh: display、Math、sym.latex，再放 expand，

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So this looks pretty good.
cues.zh: 很漂亮。

cues.en: And then just out of curiosity I'm going to get rid of this expand.
cues.zh: 好奇的話，把 expand 移除，

cues.en: So now these two lines are almost exactly the same except here I'm explicitly expanding the multiplication.
cues.zh: 兩行幾乎相同，差別是這行明確展開乘法，

cues.en: And here I just have the multiplication in here like this.
cues.zh: 另一行只是兩者相乘，像這樣。

cues.en: And here you see the difference in the output between just multiplying the polynomials versus putting the product of the polynomials through this expand function.
cues.zh: 能看到，單純相乘，和把乘積送進 expand，輸出有什麼差別。

cues.en: The exercise for this video is to implement these two polynomials here.
cues.zh: 練習是實作這兩個多項式，

cues.en: So I'm calling it f of x and y and G of X and Y.
cues.zh: 叫 f(x,y)、g(x,y)，

cues.en: These are just two functions of x and of Y.
cues.zh: 都是 x、y 的雙變數函數。

cues.en: So implement these two polynomials and then what you want to do is first multiply the polynomials together.
cues.zh: 先實作，再把它們相乘，

cues.en: So like I showed in the previous slide before switching to Python code.
cues.zh: 就像切到 Python 前的投影片，

cues.en: So multiply these two polynomials and then in the product, substitute X for five and y for minus two and you'll get some answer.
cues.zh: 相乘後，把 x 換成 5，y 換成 -2，得到某個答案，

cues.en: It's going to be some number.
cues.zh: 會是一個數字。

cues.en: And then what you want to do is substitute the same numbers.
cues.zh: 再使用相同數字代入，

cues.en: So X equals five AND Y equals minus two.
But now you're substituting into each polynomial individually and then you multiply those two numbers so this.
cues.zh: 但這次分別代入每個多項式，再把兩個數值相乘。

cues.en: So you substitute these two numbers for these two variables into f of x and y.
cues.zh: 把這兩個數字代入 f(x,y)，

cues.en: That's going to give you... whatever number it is.
cues.zh: 得到某個數值，

cues.en: And then you substitute these numbers into G of X and Y and then we'll give you some other number and then you multiply those two results. And then the goal is to test whether those two numbers are the same.
cues.zh: 再代入 g(x,y)，得到另一個數值，最後相乘，檢查兩者是否相同，

cues.en: So whether it matters whether you multiply and then substitute or substitute and then multiply.
cues.zh: 也就是先乘再代入，或先代入再乘，結果是否有差。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So good luck.
cues.zh: 祝順利，

cues.en: I hope you have fun working through this exercise.
cues.zh: 希望你練習得開心。

cues.zh: 接著切到 Python，示範解法。看看，

cues.zh: f(x,y) 是 4x 的四次方，

cues.en: I'm rearranging some of the terms a little bit here just to get the terms with the highest order the highest degree to be on the left.
cues.zh: 我稍微調整項目順序，把最高次數的放左邊，

cues.en: So then we had nine times Y cubed minus three times X squared plus X times Y squared.
cues.zh: 再 9y 三次方，減 3x 平方，再加 x 乘以 y 平方。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And then we had G of X and Y and that was point eight times y cubed.
cues.zh: g(x,y) 是 0.8y 的三次方，

cues.en: And again I'm rewriting these terms slightly and then we had X cubed and then plus six times X squared
cues.zh: 也稍微調換順序，再來 x 三次方，加 6x 平方，

cues.en: times y.
cues.zh: 乘 y。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And again if you are uncertain about whether this is X squared,
cues.zh: 如果不確定，這裡到底是 x 平方，

cues.en: so whether this is X squared times Y, or whether python is going to implement X to the power of two times
cues.zh: 乘 y，還是 Python 會算成 x 的 2y 次方，

cues.en: Y, then you have to remember the PEMDAS, so please excuse my dear and Sally: parentheses exponent multiplication
cues.zh: 就要記得 PEMDAS，Please Excuse My Dear Aunt Sally，括號、次方、乘，

cues.en: division addition and subtraction.
cues.zh: 除、加、減。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So if we leave out the parentheses then the exponent takes priority over the multiplication.
cues.zh: 不加括號，次方仍優先於乘法，

cues.en: So this is going to give us the right answer.
cues.zh: 所以會得到正確答案。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.zh: 好奇想把它們印出，display、Math，再寫，

cues.en: So this one's going to be four G of X equals.

cues.zh: 再接實際結果。

cues.zh: 多項式的乘積放進括號，當成單一 SymPy，

cues.zh: 很有趣，不管先乘多項式再代入，或先代入再乘答案，結果完全相同。

cues.en: Now the reason why this is the case is that these are linear operations -- we've just been doing all linear operations here: multiplications and additions.
cues.zh: 原因是，這些都是線性操作，我們只做了乘法、加法這些線性操作，

cues.en: And in general, when you are performing linear operations the order of operations tends not to matter.
cues.zh: 一般來說，線性操作的順序通常不影響結果，

cues.en: And when you're doing non-linear operations, nonlinear computations, then the order actually does matter.
cues.zh: 非線性運算，順序就有影響。

cues.en: So in this video I showed you more about polynomials and working with polynomials in Python and sympy.
cues.zh: 這段多介紹了多項式，以及 Python、SymPy 的操作，

cues.zh: 尤其聚焦相乘。
